stateBanner.createdBody: the agent is provisioned. once the round opens you can deposit bnb to claim your allocation.

stateBanner.closedBody: presale closed. the bundle is being prepared for the next puissant block. usually under a minute.

stateBanner.refundingBody: the bundle didn't land or the cap wasn't met. you can pull your principal plus a share of the bonus pool.

tier.pathGraduates: presale → pcs v2 lp · 50/10/20 supply split · 24h vesting
tier.pathNoGraduate: presale → pcs curve · no v2 lp graduation
tier.v2BuyHelpGraduates: bnb the platform adds to pcs v2 lp at graduation. token supply split: 50% burn / 10% treasury lp / 20% presalers / 20% locked in pcs v2 lp.
tier.v2BuyHelpSmol: SMOL does not graduate to v2; it trades on the pcs bonding curve until organic graduation.
tier.fdvHelp: fully diluted valuation includes burned supply. circulating mc removes tokens burned at launch.

vesting.fullAtLaunchBody: all presale tokens unlock the moment the round closes and trading opens.
vesting.linearNote: 50% claimable at tge, the remaining 50% vests linearly over the first 24h post-launch.

faq.title: what happens at launch
faq.aBurnedGraduates: the unsold supply (everything not bundled, including the platform's v2 buy) is burned at launch. it's why {{tier}} ships with a smaller circulating supply ({{circulatingSupplyM}}m).
faq.aBurnedNoGraduate: the unsold portion of supply is burned at launch so what trades on pcs is what presalers + traders bought. circulating supply at open is {{circulatingSupplyM}}m.
faq.aClaimVesting: 50% unlocks at tge (the moment the bundle lands). the remaining 50% vests linearly over the first 24h. you can claim any time, but only the vested portion will transfer.
faq.aClaimNoVesting: 100% unlocks at tge. trading opens and your full allocation is claimable in one tx.
faq.aBundleFails: refunds enable. you can pull your principal plus a pro-rata share of the bonus pool (penalty bnb from early withdrawals). no fee.
faq.aBnbDestinationGraduates: the round's bnb goes to bundle the launch: {{bundlePct}}% buys tokens in the same block as the deploy, {{v2BuyBnb}} bnb is added to pcs v2 lp at open. liquidity is locked. presale-side allocations get the 50% tge + 24h linear unlock.
faq.aBnbDestinationNoGraduate: the round's bnb seeds the pcs bonding curve at deploy. there's no separate v2 lp; the bonding curve is the liquidity until the token graduates organically.

terms.title: terms
terms.fcfsBody: deposits accepted until cap hits or window closes, whichever comes first. allocations are pro-rata across all backers at the close snapshot.
terms.penaltyBody: withdraw any time during the open window. {{pct}}% of the withdrawn amount stays in the bonus pool and gets added to the bundle at launch.
terms.fullRefundTitle: full refund if cap not hit
terms.fullRefundBody: if the round closes and the floor isn't reached, your deposit is refundable in full. no penalty.
terms.riskBody: agent tokens are risky. presale rounds depend on the on-chain launch flow executing cleanly. do your own research. never deposit more than you can lose.

fees.title: fees
fees.subtitle: what it costs to launch, trade, and patron an agent on waifu.fun.
fees.preGradSubtitle: while the FLAP bonding curve is filling.
fees.postGradSubtitle: every buy or sell on the graduated token.
fees.lpClaimSubtitle: when progressive V3 liquidity tiers unlock and the AgentSafe pulls fees.
fees.footnote: FLAP curve fees flow to the FLAP protocol. PCS V2 / V3 trading fees flow per Uniswap V2 / V3 mechanics. waifu.fun never custodies user funds.

rows.deployNote: creator pays only the BSC gas to push the launch tx through the FLAP Portal.
rows.tradeCurveNote: applied to every buy / sell while the bonding curve is filling. flows to the FLAP protocol, not to waifu.fun.
rows.graduationNote: paid once when the bonding curve fills and liquidity migrates to PancakeSwap V2.
rows.buySellTaxNote: applied at the token contract level on every graduated trade.
rows.splitterNote: 65% to the AgentSafe treasury, 25% to the patron wallet, 10% to the platform.
rows.tiersNote: TreasuryLP4 deploys a new V3 LP at each market-cap threshold. claim splits unlock per tier.
rows.tierSplitNote: 65% to the AgentSafe treasury, 20% to the patron, 10% buyback-and-burn (to dEaD), 5% to the platform.
